original_title: Sex-based differences in clinical outcomes of enfortumab vedotin and NECTIN-4 expression in urothelial cancer
title: Enfortumab vedotin works better in men, and NECTIN-4 might be why
blurb: A retrospective international cohort on enfortumab vedotin in metastatic urothelial cancer finds men living longer and staying on treatment longer than women. TCGA data shows higher NECTIN-4 expression in men too, which at least gives the gap a plausible mechanism instead of leaving it as a bare correlation.

original_title: Selective C–S/C–O Bond Formation toward Biaryl Sulfones and Sulfinate Esters Involved with Cyclic Diaryliodoniums
title: One reaction, two products: biaryl sulfones or sulfinate esters, just flip a switch
blurb: Cyclic diaryliodonium salts plus sodium sulfinates, run metal-free in hot DMSO, give biaryl sulfones in up to 94% yield via selective C–S bond formation. Add a catalyst to the same mix and it swings to C–O bond formation instead. The divergence from one starting combination is the actual trick.

original_title: Two-color, laser-induced fluorometry for evaluating the efficiency of click chemistry-based labeling of extracellular vesicles.
title: Checking whether your click-chemistry tag actually stuck to the vesicle
blurb: A two-color laser-induced fluorometry method for measuring how efficiently a click-chemistry label actually attaches to extracellular vesicles. A QC tool rather than a discovery, but EV labeling work could use one.

original_title: Asymmetric Total Synthesis of Neostenine, Neotuberostemonine, and the Putative Structure of Tuberostemonine L
title: A 3-aza-Cope cascade builds three Stemona alkaloids in one run
blurb: Asymmetric total synthesis of neostenine, neotuberostemonine, and the proposed structure of tuberostemonine L, starting from a chiral piperidine and running elimination, a 3-aza-Cope rearrangement, and a Mannich cyclization in a single cascade to set a tricyclic aminoketone on multigram scale. Taking on an unconfirmed structure (tuberostemonine L) alongside the known targets means this synthesis is also doing structure-proof duty.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: T-DM1 Shows Limited Activity After T-DXd in HER2-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer - Bioengineer.org
title: Switching from T-DXd to T-DM1 doesn't buy HER2+ patients much
blurb: In HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer, T-DM1 shows limited activity when given after T-DXd. Sequencing the two ADCs isn't a free second bite, which matters for what oncologists reach for once T-DXd stops working.

original_title: Novel Radiotracers in PET Imaging.
title: A PET radiotracer roundup, not a new result
blurb: A review chapter in Radiologic Clinics surveying what's new in PET radiotracers. No data of its own here, just the state of the field.

original_title: Unlocking Diverse Asymmetric Three‐Component Reactions via Crowding Effects Within DNA Scaffolds
title: DNA scaffolds turn crowding into stereocontrol
blurb: A DNA-based catalyst that runs asymmetric three-component reactions by letting substrate binding crowd the local environment around activated enones, boxing in where the nucleophile and electrophile sit relative to each other. Biocatalytic versions of these reactions have lagged behind small-molecule catalysts, so getting DNA to do the job through steric confinement rather than a dedicated pocket is the interesting part.

original_title: Probing the kinetics of the aluminum fluoride chelation
title: Clocking how fast aluminum fluoride actually chelates
blurb: A kinetics study of Al-F chelation, the step underlying 18F-AlF radiolabeling. No new tracer here, just the plumbing data that decides whether a labeling protocol behaves the way people assume it does.

original_title: Toward AI-agent-assisted reaction intelligence: a mechanistically informed framework for predictive SuFEx chemistry
title: Letting an AI agent reason through SuFEx mechanisms
blurb: A framework that has an AI agent work from reaction mechanism rather than brute pattern-matching to predict SuFEx chemistry outcomes. Thin on detail beyond that pitch.

original_title: Bridging Research and Industry to Advance Actinium-225 Cancer Therapies - International Atomic Energy Agency
title: IAEA plays matchmaker for actinium-225
blurb: An IAEA push to get research groups and industry talking so actinium-225 production can actually scale for cancer therapy. More a convening than a result, but supply has been the bottleneck on alpha therapy for years.

original_title: Facile Synthesis of a Bis-α-aryl-Substituted Pyclen-Based Heptadentate Lanthanide Chelator for Ultra-Robust and High-Contrast MRI Agents and for Radiopharmaceuticals.
title: A pyclen chelator built to do double duty, MRI and radiopharma
blurb: A heptadentate pyclen ligand with two aryl groups added to the backbone, made as a lanthanide chelator for high-contrast MRI agents that's pitched as robust enough for radiopharmaceuticals too. One scaffold covering both imaging jobs instead of swapping chelators between them.

original_title: Beyond Prostate-Specific Antigen Response: Could 18 F-FDG PET Refine Patient Selection for Rechallenge with [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA-617?
title: Maybe FDG PET, not PSA, should decide who gets re-dosed with Lu-PSMA
blurb: Asks whether 18F-FDG PET can pick out which patients should get rechallenged with [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617, since PSA response alone isn't a great selection tool. If FDG uptake flags who'll actually benefit, that's a sharper gate than watching PSA numbers bounce around.

original_title: Coordination chemistry-driven dynamic crosslinked hydrogel platform with ROS/pH responsiveness and photothermal activity for osteoporotic bone defect repair.
title: A hydrogel that releases and heats on cue for bone repair
blurb: A coordination-chemistry crosslinked hydrogel for osteoporotic bone defects that responds to both ROS and pH at the injury site and layers on photothermal activity. Three triggers stacked into one material is a lot to claim at once, cleaner data would help separate signal from marketing copy.

original_title: Late-Stage Catalytic Borylation of Unprotected Peptides
title: Sticking boronic acids onto peptides after they're already made
blurb: Late-stage palladium-catalyzed borylation turns an aryl iodide on an unprotected peptide into a boronic acid, using a preformed Lewis-base complex of tetrahydroxydiboron to make it work without protecting groups. Peptide-boronic acids are a newish class of biologics and methods for building them have been thin, so a route that skips the protecting-group gymnastics is the useful part.

original_title: (68)Ga/(177)Lu-Labeled Seribantumab as the Theranostic Drugs in Treating HER3-Positive Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
title: One antibody, two radioisotopes, for HER3-positive liver cancer
blurb: Seribantumab labeled with both 68Ga and 177Lu as a theranostic pair: PET to find HER3-positive hepatocellular carcinoma, Lu-177 to treat it. Same antibody doing both the finding and the treating, the usual theranostic pitch, aimed at a cancer that doesn't get much of this kind of attention.

original_title: Combining anionic and neutral ligands for kinetic stereocontrol in nickel catalysis
title: Getting nickel to pick the cyclohexane stereoisomer it doesn't want
blurb: A dual-ligand nickel system, anionic plus neutral, runs a three-component 1,1-arylfunctionalization of methylenecyclohexanes to build substituted cyclohexanes under kinetic control. The point is reaching the thermodynamically disfavored stereoisomer, the one the reaction would normally relax away from.

original_title: Lonza rounds out Swiss ADC expansion's scope with mid-scale capabilities - Fierce Pharma
title: Lonza fills in the middle of its ADC capacity
blurb: The Swiss ADC expansion picks up mid-scale manufacturing, closing the gap between pilot batches and full commercial runs. Capacity news, not a data readout.

original_title: Botulinum Toxin Plus Transdermal Scopolamine Reduces Salivary Gland Uptake in Patients Undergoing Tandem Radiopharmaceutical Therapy with [ 225 Ac]Ac- and [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA Radioligands
title: Keeping Ac-225/Lu-177 PSMA therapy from wrecking your salivary glands
blurb: Botox plus a transdermal scopolamine patch cuts salivary gland uptake in patients getting tandem Ac-225 and Lu-177 PSMA radioligand therapy. Worth watching since dry mouth is one of the main reasons this treatment is hard to tolerate.

original_title: Patterns of Progression on Posttreatment Imaging During [ 177 Lu]Lu-PSMA Radiopharmaceutical Therapy
title: How Lu-177 PSMA therapy actually fails, mapped on imaging
blurb: A look at posttreatment scans to characterize where and how disease progresses during Lu-177 PSMA radioligand therapy.

original_title: In vivo-compatible spatial multi-omics via hydrogen peroxide-independent APEX2 labeling
title: APEX2 proximity labeling without the hydrogen peroxide
blurb: APEX2 normally needs a hydrogen peroxide pulse to trigger, which is awkward for anything alive. Swapping in tetrazine-phenol probes lets it catalyze labeling without the peroxide, opening up spatial profiling of protein and RNA localization and interactions in vivo instead of just fixed cells.

original_title: Continuous mass measurement of single proteins
title: Watching one protein's mass drift for an hour straight
blurb: Mass photometry that tracks an individual protein, and whatever it binds, continuously for up to an hour instead of a single snapshot. Following mass over time is what actually lets you catch interactions forming and falling apart, which is the point if you care about mechanism rather than just a weigh-in.

original_title: Investigation on pain factors and ethanol concentration predictive value in 68Ga-labeled PET imaging agent injection
title: Why 68Ga PET injections hurt, and whether ethanol content gives it away
blurb: A look at what drives injection pain with 68Ga-labeled PET tracers, testing whether the ethanol concentration in the formulation predicts it.

original_title: PSMA Theranostics for Prostate Cancer: Evidence, Pitfalls, and Implementation in Japan.
title: Bringing PSMA theranostics to Japan, warts included
blurb: A review of the evidence behind PSMA theranostics for prostate cancer alongside the practical pitfalls of actually standing it up in Japan. A rollout reality check, not new trial data.

original_title: Universal protein immobilization and digestion reactor facilitates deep quantitative proteomic analysis of single Caenorhabditis elegans individuals
title: A reactor built to handle one whole worm's worth of protein
blurb: SPIDR-C combines worm disruption, surfactant extraction, and covalent protein immobilization in a single reactor to get deep quantitative proteomics out of one C. elegans, cuticle and all. Population averages wash out worm-to-worm variation, so profiling individuals one at a time is the actual point.

original_title: Directed Evolution of Artificial Enzyme with a Catalytic Noncanonical Amino Acid for Asymmetric Friedel–Crafts Alkylation of Cyclic Enones with Indoles
title: An evolved enzyme that activates enones the way biocatalysis usually can't
blurb: A fully genetically encoded artificial enzyme uses a catalytic noncanonical amino acid, a primary amine, to form an iminium ion on cyclic enones that are normally too weak an electrophile for enzymes to bother with. That unlocks an enantioselective Friedel-Crafts alkylation with indoles that wasn't really accessible to biocatalysis before.

original_title: Lysinoalanine crosslinking in the extracellular flagellar hook of Synergistota.
title: The flagellar hook that welds itself shut
blurb: Synergistota apparently crosslink their extracellular flagellar hook with lysinoalanine, a lysine-to-dehydroalanine bond usually associated with cooked food proteins, not bacterial nanomachines built to survive outside the cell.

original_title: Total Synthesis, Absolute Configurational Determination, and Antifouling Activity Evaluation of Cretenyne B
title: Pinning down cretenyne B's last two stereocenters
blurb: The tetrahydrofuran ring's configuration was already known, but C6 and C13 weren't. They nailed it down by comparing NMR data against the C6 isomers of cretenyne A they'd already made, then confirmed it with total synthesis and ran antifouling assays on both candidate diastereomers.

original_title: A metallopeptide model for the active site of cobalt nitrile hydratase reveals coupled metal and cysteine oxidation during active-site maturation
title: Watching a nitrile hydratase active site build itself
blurb: An eight-residue peptide mimic of cobalt nitrile hydratase's bizarre Cys/amide-N coordination sphere shows metal binding and cysteine oxidation to sulfenic/sulfinic acid happening as a coupled process during maturation, not metal-first-then-oxidize like you'd assume.

original_title: Prostate-specific Membrane Antigen PET/Computed Tomography in Prostate Cancer: Staging, Restaging, Interpretation, and Clinical Management.
title: A review of what PSMA PET/CT is actually good for
blurb: A clinical rundown of PSMA PET/CT in prostate cancer, covering staging, restaging, scan interpretation, and how it's changing management. No new data here, just the state of the art laid out.

original_title: Ruthenium-catalyzed strategies for the synthesis of bioactive heterocycles
title: Ruthenium's pitch for building heterocycles
blurb: A review of ruthenium-catalyzed routes into bioactive heterocycles, leaning on Ru's multiple oxidation states and C-H activation chemistry to do things other metals don't do as cleanly. Useful roundup, no new chemistry of its own.

original_title: Photocatalytic Synthesis of 1,2-Dihydroquinolines via SET-Desilylation-Triggered Vinyl Radical Cyclization of N -(α-Silyl)glycinates
title: Methylene blue photocatalysis builds dihydroquinolines
blurb: Visible light and methylene blue oxidize an N-silyl glycinate, desilylation kicks out an alpha-amino radical that adds to DMAD, and the resulting vinyl radical cyclizes onto the arene and rearomatizes to give 1,2-dihydroquinolines in moderate to high yield. No metal catalyst needed, just a dye and light.

original_title: Biocatalysts for Peptide Geranylation With Linear and Cyclic Prenyl Groups
title: Enzymes for stapling prenyl groups onto peptides
blurb: Prenyltransferases from ribosomal peptide pathways can bolt linear prenyl groups onto peptides with solid chemo- and regioselectivity, useful for juicing up bioactivity. The fusion enzyme NctPC takes it further, installing a whole polycyclic isoprenoid in one shot.

original_title: Roche returns to Hansoh with broad $15B ADC deal - BioSpace
title: Roche goes back to Hansoh for more ADCs, $15B this time
blurb: Roche re-upping with Hansoh on antibody-drug conjugates in a deal worth $15B. That's the headline; no word yet on which targets or how much is actual cash versus milestones.

original_title: β‐C(sp 3 )─H Arylation of Aliphatic Sulfonamides
title: Sulfonamides finally get their C-H arylation moment
blurb: Carboxylic acid directing groups have handled sp3 C-H arylation for a while; sulfonamides hadn't gotten the same treatment until now. A purpose-built N-acetyl thioether ligand does the beta-arylation with a broad substrate range.

original_title: Selective Electrochemical E –Semihydrogenation of Alkyl Alkynes with Main Metal Electrodes and Water
title: Semihydrogenating alkynes with sacrificial Mg and Al electrodes
blurb: Alkyl alkynes are notoriously hard to stop cleanly at the E-alkene, but Mg/Al electrodes running in THF/water pull it off at over 98% Faradaic efficiency while dodging the usual hydrogen evolution problem. Works on aromatic alkynes too, and doubles as a deuteration method.

original_title: Optimisation and Validation of a UHPLC-MS/MS Assay Using Timed Post-Column Ammonium Fluoride Infusion for Sensitive Serum Steroids Quantitation
title: A fluoride trick to make steroids ionize better
blurb: Post-column ammonium fluoride infusion, timed to the run, boosts ionization enough to quantify 18 serum steroids in one UHPLC-MS/MS shot, mineralocorticoids through androgens, including the 11-oxygenated ones that usually get ignored because they barely ionize. A methods paper, but the kind that actually gets used in a clinical lab.

original_title: Zymeworks Presents New Phase 1 Data for Folate Receptor - GlobeNewswire
title: Zymeworks drops early folate receptor data
blurb: New Phase 1 numbers for a folate-receptor program, straight off the press release. No actual figures to chew on yet, so this is one to revisit once the data itself shows up rather than just the announcement that it exists.

original_title: Interweaving Two‐Dimensional Co‐Corrole‐Based Covalent Organic Framework for Significantly Improved Electrocatalytic Oxygen Reduction Reaction
title: Pillaring a 2D COF so the layers stop sliding on you
blurb: A cobalt-corrole 2D COF normally suffers the usual problems: buried active sites, slow transport between layers, and sheets that slide around during catalysis. Pyrazine and bipyridine pillars interweave the layers into two derivatives, and oxygen reduction activity jumps significantly as a result. The pillaring is the actual fix here, not just a structural flex.

original_title: Fluoride-Enabled Assembly of Iron–Hydrogen-Bonded Frameworks as Bifunctional Lewis Acid–Base Catalysts for Knoevenagel Condensation
title: An iron framework that's its own acid and base catalyst
blurb: Two new fluoride-mediated iron hydrogen-bonded frameworks, JOU-40 and JOU-41, built from [Fe3F11] chains linked by O-H...F bonds. The iron centers are Lewis acidic and the fluorides are basic, so the same recyclable solid handles both ends of a Knoevenagel condensation without a separate base, and solvent-free at that.

original_title: Visible-Light-Driven Dehydrogenative Ketone Synthesis from Unprotected Primary Alcohols and Aryl Bromides
title: Turning alcohols straight into ketones with light, no protecting groups
blurb: A bromine-radical HAT step paired with a nickel relay, driven by visible light, couples unprotected primary alcohols directly with aryl bromides into aryl alkyl ketones at room temperature. Direct C-H oxidative coupling of alcohols to ketones is rare, since everyone usually detours through activating the O-H or C-O bond first, so skipping that step is the actual news.

original_title: Unlocking Diverse Asymmetric Three‐Component Reactions via Crowding Effects Within DNA Scaffolds
title: Cramming three components into a DNA scaffold for asymmetric catalysis
blurb: A DNA-based catalyst that gets its stereoselectivity from crowding: substrates binding close enough inside the chiral scaffold that the steric squeeze organizes nucleophile and electrophile around the enone. Biocatalytic three-component asymmetric reactions are generally underdeveloped, so turning the crowding itself into the catalytic feature is the neat part.

original_title: Toward the Synthesis of Verteporfin from Hemin and Protoporphyrin IX
title: Two routes to verteporfin, one starting from blood
blurb: A synthesis of verteporfin, the photodynamic therapy photosensitizer, from either commercial protoporphyrin IX or, more interestingly, from hemin. The hemin route strips the iron and esterifies to reach PpIX dimethyl ester, then builds the benzoporphyrin skeleton with a Diels-Alder against DMAD. Starting from a blood-derived feedstock instead of just buying PpIX is the point.

original_title: Carbon Nanotube-Amplified Optical Macro-Glycoligands for Probing Glycan−Protein Interactions
title: Carbon nanotubes to catch a weak glycan-protein handshake
blurb: Glycan-protein binding is usually too weak and fleeting for standard label-free assays to register, so this builds carbon-nanotube-amplified glycoligands that boost the optical signal enough to read the interaction directly. A tool paper, aimed at a measurement problem that's actually been a bottleneck rather than a flashy result on its own.

original_title: Switchable [4 + 3] or [3 + 3] Annulation of Pyrazolidinones with Diazoarylidene Succinimides for the Divergent Synthesis of Fused Benzodiazepines and Quinolines
title: Same starting materials, two different rings depending on the additive
blurb: Rh(III)-catalyzed C-H activation on 1-phenylpyrazolidinone branches into a [4+3] annulation with AgOAc in HFIP, giving fused benzodiazepines, or a [3+3] annulation with Zn(OAc)2 in THF, giving quinolines, off the same starting pair. Swapping additive and solvent is the whole switch, a tidy bit of control for two scaffold classes out of one reaction.

original_title: Meta ‐Selective C─H Monofluoroalkylation of Pyridines With Difluoroalkyl Radicals
title: Finally hitting the meta position on pyridine C-H fluoroalkylation
blurb: Every prior method for sticking a monofluoroalkyl group onto a pyridine only manages the ortho position, even though that group is valued anywhere on the ring in drug design. This one generates dihydropyridines in situ and runs them against difluoroalkyl radicals through a defluorination/olefin isomerization cascade to land meta-selectively instead, the first report of that regiochemistry.

original_title: Host–Guest Inclusion Self-Assembly of Zero-Dimensional Metal Halides for Enhanced Photocatalytic Amine Coupling
title: A cage around the halide fixes 0D photocatalysts' usual ailments
blurb: 0D metal halides are normally unstable, lose charge carriers fast, and barely react at their surface. Caging ZnCl4 and MnCl4 anions inside an anthracene-pyridine macrocycle via one-pot self-assembly addresses stability and recombination at once, and the resulting host-guest crystals actually push amine coupling photocatalysis forward.

original_title: Redox-Active Esters as Versatile Precursors for the In Situ Construction of Covalent Au–C(sp3) Molecular Contacts
title: Gold-carbon contacts made by kicking out CO2
blurb: NHP esters, built to shed CO2 irreversibly, get repurposed as single-electron precursors that snap together covalent Au-C(sp3) bonds right inside an STM break junction. The CO2 loss acts as the thermodynamic spring driving the whole reaction, a cleaner route to interfaces that are usually a pain to form on demand.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Active Metal Template Synthesis of Rotaxanes From BINOL‐Phosphate Macrocycles
title: Rotaxanes threaded through a chiral BINOL-phosphate hoop
blurb: Active metal template synthesis finally gets a macrocycle that isn't nitrogen-based: BINOL-phosphate rings threaded via Cu(I) click chemistry, giving 17 differently functionalized chiral [2]rotaxanes in yields up to 93%. DFT, kinetics, and controls point to a dinuclear phosphate-Cu2 intermediate as the reason threading wins out kinetically.

original_title: Tungsten-Mediated Coupling of Dienes and Anilines for the Construction of 1,4-Amino Alcohols
title: Tungsten swaps in for nitrosobenzene in amino alcohol synthesis
blurb: A W(VI) precatalyst couples anilines and dienes directly into 1,4-amino alcohols in one step from cheap, available starting materials, a practical alternative to the usual nitrosobenzene routes. Bulkier groups on the tungsten center actually improve catalysis, a steric effect worth filing away.

original_title: Inside Back Cover: Direct Observation of Radical‐Mediated Oxide‐to‐Alloy Transformation in Solution Under Pulsed Laser Irradiation
title: Catching an oxide flip into an alloy in real time
blurb: Pulsed laser irradiation in solution drives a radical-mediated transformation from oxide to alloy, caught directly as it happens rather than reconstructed afterward.

original_title: Hypervalent Iodine(III) versus Sulfonium Salts as Electrophilic Group-Transfer Reagents: A Comparative Review of Stability, Reactivity, Safety and Sustainability
title: Iodine(III) vs sulfonium salts: the electrophilic group-transfer rematch
blurb: A head-to-head review of the two reagent families behind most polarity-reversed group transfers (CF3, alkynyl, cyano, aryl, vinyl), judged on stability, reactivity, safety, and sustainability rather than cherry-picked wins. Iodine(III)'s three-center four-electron bond against sulfonium's plain octet, settled on practical grounds instead of habit.
venue: UPI Journal of Chemical and Life Sciences

original_title: Multi-Scale Light-Based Biofabrication of Acrylate-Free Magnetic Gelatin Composites for Transient Vascular Navigation
title: A magnetic gelatin ink that skips the acrylate
blurb: Native gelatin gets photocrosslinked via ruthenium-mediated di-tyrosine coupling instead of methacrylation, so it keeps its native bioactivity, then gets loaded with zinc-substituted iron oxide nanoparticles for magnetic steering. The obvious catch: more nanoparticles for stronger magnetic response means less light getting through to cure it, and that trade-off still has to be picked for any actual vascular navigation device.

original_title: Design and Synthesis of Photoswitchable Conjugated Dithienylethene-Naphthalimide Scaffolds: Applications in Molecular Logic and Anticounterfeiting
title: One switch, three ways to flip the same fluorescence
blurb: A dithienylethene-naphthalimide-aniline hybrid toggles its fluorescence with light as well as acid and base, routed through photoinduced electron transfer and energy transfer. Aimed at molecular logic gates and anticounterfeiting tags, which is where most multi-stimulus switches like this end up anyway.

original_title: Classic and cutting-edge strategies for cyclopropanation
title: Cyclopropanation, old tricks and new ones, in one review
blurb: A survey of classic and newer routes to cyclopropanes, the ring that keeps showing up in natural products and APIs, flagging where current methods still fall short on complex targets.

original_title: Ring-Expansion/Cross-Coupling Cascade of Ketones via Radical Sorting
title: Sorting radicals to expand a ring and cross-couple in the same step
blurb: A dual photoredox/nickel system expands saturated ketone rings by one carbon while cross-coupling in a carboxylic acid-derived partner, all in a single cascade driven by radical sorting. It works across a genuinely wide span of ring sizes, from 5- up to 16-membered, which is what makes an otherwise niche move useful for building scaffolds in one operation.

original_title: Sapogenin-Based Molecular Switches: Design and Synthesis of Azobenzene-Linked Steroid Dimers
title: Steroid dimers that flip with light, thanks to one hydroxyl's angle
blurb: Azobenzene-linked steroid dimer switches built from sapogenin precursors via iodination at C3. The neat part is that whether you get clean substitution or elimination there comes down entirely to whether that C3-OH sits axial or equatorial at the A/B ring junction.

original_title: Radiation-Crosslinked Protein Hydrogels and Nanogels: Preparation and Applications in Cell Culture and Nanomedicine.
title: A protocol chapter on protein hydrogels and nanogels
blurb: Radiation crosslinking turns proteins into hydrogels and nanogels for cell culture and nanomedicine. A methods-book writeup rather than a new result.

original_title: Photoresponsive Ruthenium(II) Isomeric Switches in Solution: Leveraging Asymmetry in Ligand Design for Precision in Photoactivated Chemotherapy
title: Flip the ligand, change how the Ru complex reacts to light
blurb: A series of Ru(II) terpyridine isomers built from unsymmetrical picolylamine/picolylimine donors, with four crystal structures showing that donor placement alone reshapes the excited state. Aimed at photoactivated chemotherapy and triggered with visible light, but this is still solution chemistry, nowhere near a cell yet.

original_title: Improved Two-Step Synthesis of d -Penicillamine: Mechanistic Insights and Structural Identification of Key Process-Related Substances
title: D-penicillamine synthesis nearly doubles its yield
blurb: A two-step route from penicillin G potassium pushes isolated yield from 39.94% to 69.20%, using HPLC-guided stepwise feeding to isolate and identify the process-related byproducts along the way. First paper to actually pin down which reaction pathway dominates.

original_title: PET Imaging of Infection, Inflammation, and Immune-mediated Disease: From Fluorodeoxyglucose to Pathogen-specific and Immune-targeted Tracers.
title: A tour of PET tracers for infection and inflammation
blurb: A review walking through PET tracers beyond FDG, pathogen-specific and immune-targeted ones, for imaging infection, inflammation, and immune-mediated disease.

original_title: Structural conservation and expanded functionality of hyper‐stable human serum albumin variants
title: Redesigned albumin, more stable without losing its day job
blurb: Heavily mutated human serum albumin variants, built on an earlier design effort, that stay hyper-stable while keeping the structural features behind FcRn-mediated half-life and small-molecule binding. The pitch is skipping serum extraction or yeast/mammalian production, which is costly and hard to reproduce, but this is still a protein design paper, not a product.

original_title: Suppressing Ru Deactivation Through Lattice Hydrogen and Hydroxyl Adsorption Engineering for High‐Performing Alkaline Fuel Cells
title: Keeping Ru catalysts from poisoning themselves in alkaline fuel cells
blurb: Ru's hydrogen oxidation activity in alkaline fuel cells collapses at high anodic potential because *OH piles up on the surface. The fix is a Pd-core, multi-element Ru-skin catalyst that balances *OH coverage against hydrogen supply, designed straight off that mechanistic picture instead of by trial and error.

original_title: PET in Theranostics: Patient Selection, Treatment Planning, and Response Assessment.
title: PET's role across theranostics
blurb: A review on using PET for patient selection, treatment planning, and response assessment in theranostics.

original_title: Synthesis and Characterization of the Nitrosonium Borosulfates (NO)[B(SO4)2] and (NO)[B(S2O7)2]
title: First nitrosonium borosulfates land, two bridge types included
blurb: Cooking boron oxide in oleum with nitrosonium cations gives the first NO borosulfates, (NO)[B(SO4)2] and (NO)[B(S2O7)2], and tuning boron content and temperature steers which one forms, S-O-S bridges or B-O-S. A new compound class, crystal structures and all, if mostly a structural curiosity for now.

original_title: Visible-Light-Driven Access to S -2-Pyridyl Phosphorodithioates from P4S10 via Cascade Phosphorodithiolation/Cyclization
title: P4S10 goes cascade: pyridyl phosphorodithioates in one visible-light pot
blurb: Visible light drives a cascade phosphorodithiolation/cyclization straight off P4S10 as the phosphorus source, with alcohols doing double duty as activators, to build S-2-pyridyl phosphorodithioates from malononitrile precursors. Broad substrate scope and good-to-excellent yields, by their own numbers.

original_title: Eight biotech companies spearheading the antibody drug conjugate new wave - Labiotech.eu
title: Who's pushing ADCs into their next phase
blurb: A Labiotech roundup of eight biotech companies working on the newer generation of antibody-drug conjugates. It's a landscape piece rather than a result, but a decent map of who's in the race.

original_title: Discovery of a Novel Pyrido[2,1- h ]pteridin-6-one Derivative as a Potent and Orally Bioavailable HPK1 Inhibitor
title: A new scaffold for the HPK1 inhibitor nobody's gotten approved yet
blurb: HPK1 keeps T cells in check, which makes it an attractive immunotherapy target that's stayed stubbornly undrugged. This one builds a new pyrido[2,1-h]pteridin-6-one core off a known diaminopyrimidine carboxamide hit, scaffold-hopped and optimized into something potent and orally bioavailable. Worth watching given the empty approval shelf, but it's still a preclinical lead.

original_title: Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen PET/CT Complements MRI for Focal Therapy Selection in Prostate Cancer: A Whole-Mount Histopathologic Study
title: PSMA PET/CT fills in what MRI misses for prostate focal therapy
blurb: A whole-mount histopathology study checking whether PSMA PET/CT adds real information on top of MRI when picking lesions for focal therapy in prostate cancer, using actual removed-prostate tissue as ground truth instead of imaging alone.

original_title: Catalyst regeneration enables durable electrochemical ammonia cracking for H<sub>2</sub> production
title: A catalyst that survives 500 hours of cracking ammonia for H2
blurb: Platinum on nitrogen-doped carbon with isolated Fe sites, built for electrochemical ammonia cracking at a serious 1.5 A/cm2. The Fe sites keep the Pt from oxidizing and clear out the poisonous nitrogen species that usually kill these catalysts, which is how it runs stable for 500 hours instead of the usual slow death.

original_title: ProPepBA: a binding affinity database for canonical and chemically modified protein-peptide interactions.
title: A database for how tightly peptides actually bind
blurb: ProPepBA collects binding affinity data for protein-peptide interactions, covering both canonical peptides and chemically modified ones. A reference tool rather than a discovery, but useful if you're building or testing a binding predictor.

original_title: Construction of Acenaphtho[1,2- b ]quinolines through Cyclization of 8-Alkynyl-1-naphthonitriles with Diaryliodonium Salts
title: Skipping the copper to build acenaphtho-quinolines
blurb: Diaryliodonium salts usually need copper to activate nitriles, but this route does it metal-free, then closes the ring with an intramolecular [2+2+2] to build acenaphtho[1,2-b]quinolines. Substituent tolerance is broad, and they checked the fluorescence, finding emission wavelength tracks with where the substituents sit.

original_title: Site Specific Hydration Contributes to the Thermal Stability of Proteins and Protein-Complexes
title: D2O makes proteins sturdier, and now there's a site to blame
blurb: Swapping H2O for D2O raises the thermal transition temperature of a model two-state folder (CI-2) and the barnase-barstar complex, and this paper pins the stabilization to specific hydration sites rather than a generic solvent effect. They get there by combining variable-temperature ion mobility mass spec with MD, catching hydration interactions that bulk measurements usually average away.

original_title: Acid‐Catalyzed Alternating Copolymerization of Oxetane With Cyclic Anhydride
title: Oxetane polymerizes itself first, then gets talked into being a polyester
blurb: Acid-catalyzed copolymerization of oxetanes with cyclic anhydrides, run with various Lewis and Brønsted acid catalysts, makes aliphatic polyesters with tunable structure. The proposed mechanism is odd: the oxetane races ahead to form polyether on its own first, then chain transfer converts it into the polyester.

original_title: Dynamically and Reversibly Functionalized Self-Assembled Platelets via Noncovalent Interactions
title: Polymer platelets that swap their surface chemistry without breaking a bond
blurb: Noncovalent handles, cyclodextrin, barbituric acid, and relatives, get stuck onto polycaprolactone platelets made by crystallization-driven self-assembly, so the surface functionality can be reconfigured under mild conditions instead of the harsh covalent chemistry this field usually leans on. The functionalization is also region-selective, so different faces of the platelet can carry different groups.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Exciton Diffusion Drives Efficiency Roll-off in TADF OLEDs
title: What's actually driving TADF OLEDs to dim at high brightness
blurb: Efficiency roll-off at high luminance has dogged TADF OLEDs for years, and this pins a chunk of it on singlet exciton diffusion, with the overlap between an emitter's photoluminescence and absorption spectra working as a strong predictor of how bad the roll-off gets. Useful as a screening rule if it holds, since it's a spectral property you can check before ever building the device.

original_title: A Versatile Photoelectrochemical Nanopipette Platform for In Situ Profiling of Intracellular Metabolites
title: One nanopipette, whatever metabolite you're chasing inside the cell
blurb: A photoelectrochemical nanopipette built so the sensing chemistry on its tip can be swapped out rather than rebuilt from scratch for each metabolite, aimed at single-cell profiling where you actually need that flexibility. The pitch is versatility, not a new target per se, so the real test is how many metabolites it's actually been run against.

original_title: Isomorphic Cu‐Doped Ag Nanoclusters for Water‐Modulated Conversion of Propargylic Alcohols and CO 2 to Cyclic Carbonates or α‐Hydroxy Ketones
title: Same catalyst, two products, water's the switch
blurb: A copper-doped silver nanocluster with exposed Ag-Cu sites turns propargylic alcohols and CO2 into cyclic carbonates at 98% when dry, or alpha-hydroxy ketones when water's added. One feedstock, one catalyst, and water alone decides which product you get, which is the kind of selectivity knob that's usually a separate catalyst's job.

original_title: Quantification of Upadacitinib, Dasatinib, Ruxolitinib, Imatinib, and Cabozantinib in Plasma With Liquid Chromatography-Tandem Mass Spectrometry
title: One LC-MS/MS run for five kinase inhibitors with wildly different dosing ranges
blurb: A validated LC-MS/MS method that quantifies upadacitinib, dasatinib, ruxolitinib, imatinib, and cabozantinib together in plasma, despite their therapeutic concentrations spanning very different ranges. Useful if you're actually doing drug monitoring across patients on different TKIs, less exciting if you only need one.
